name: balance_white measures a passive white-hit baseline for the player and its pet, both ways
contract: balance_white reuses SpawnBalanceEnemies (Task 2) and the SMSG_ATTACKERSTATEUPDATE parsing behind melee_attacks_taken (Task 3), extended to decode HitInfo/TargetState into CoAGameplay::Balance::SwingResult. Raise: Ghoul 500971 (creature 50073) gives the Necromancer a pet. Against a single level 36 Scarlet Soldier (4286, the same dungeon spawn Task 2/4 use), Phase A keeps the player and its ghoul passive (owned units get REACT_PASSIVE) while the enemy swings 20 times at the player, then 20 times at the ghoul; Phase B pacifies and roots the enemy (UNIT_FLAG_PACIFIED/UNIT_FLAG_DISABLE_MOVE) and lets the player and ghoul auto-attack it 20 times each, in parallel. A UnitScript clamp (BalanceWhiteGuard) keeps whichever side is being measured at 1 HP instead of letting a swing kill it, since the packet already carries the uncapped hit before DealDamage reduces health, so the recorded swing data is unaffected by the clamp. The record's balance_white.received/given map 'player' and 'pet:50073' to swing counts by result and the average non-crit/non-glancing hit, in absolute value and percent of the victim's own max health (the enemy's, for the given side). balance_white_<field> metrics read that record with a required 'side' (received|given) and an optional 'pet' boolean (default the player).
